title: Rava bar Chaklai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He asks Rav Huna a question in [Eruvin 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.67b.5). Hyman reports that Yuchasin reads Rabbah bar Chakula, and so does Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rava bar Chaklai as the sage who asks Rav Huna.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3181&lang=en) heads the notice Rabbah bar Chakula but quotes the Bavli as Rava bar Chaklai. Hyman reports Rabbah bar Chakula in Yuchasin and Dikdukei Soferim.
